robotwin2_official.name: RoboTwin 2.0 official (Co-train leaderboard protocol)
robotwin2_official.train: 50 tasks x 50 demo_clean episodes = 2,500 episodes (aloha-agilex, 14-D joints, 3 cameras 640x480 -> model input)
robotwin2_official.eval: 50 tasks x {demo_clean (Easy), demo_randomized (Hard = clean2random)} x 100 episodes, seed 0, unseen instructions, expert-filtered
robotwin2_official.metrics: clean / random / overall = mean(clean, random), success rate %
robotwin2_official.note: leaderboard rows by the RoboTwin team are trained with each model's XPolicyLab train.sh default recipe.

zzm500.name: zzm 500-episode subset (internal, NOT comparable with the leaderboard)
zzm500.train: fixed 500 episodes (50 tasks x 10, seed 42) drawn from robotwin_unified (27,500 = 50 x (50 clean + 500 randomized)), so ~90% of training demos are randomized scenes
zzm500.eval: 50 tasks x {clean, randomized} x 10 valid episodes (1,000 episodes), unseen instructions
zzm500.note: same pi0.5 scores 14.5% here vs 58.4% on the leaderboard; 'random' here is in-distribution.

fastwam_subset10.name: Fast-WAM 10-task check (internal)

fastwam_subset10.note: not a leaderboard number (randomized scenes were in the training data).

variants.name: Duo-DiT v1 (DINO-DiT, from scratch)
variants.host: DINOv2-B + 8x512 DiT-flow (va_bimanual_b DiTFlowPolicy), no language model, CLIP text token as instruction
variants.streams: two separate DiTFlowPolicy copies; each reads head + OWN wrist DINO tokens + own 7-d state (+2 presence flags)
variants.coupling: CrossArm (own Attention, qk-norm off in v1) after blocks 2,4,6,8, both directions, separate weights, tanh gain zero-init
variants.gate: FK contact rule (S/A frames -> 1) from contact_v1.npy at train, contact_rules.gate_online at eval; cross_drop optional
variants.init: from scratch (R3) or from two per-arm R0 checkpoints via rt/make_duo_init.py (R3b/R3c)

variants.name: Duo-DiT v2 (+ future-contact head, critical-point weights)
variants.gate: rule OR learned head (--head_contact, DUO_EVAL_GATE = or|head|rule); per-step loss weights around contact transitions (loss_step_w)
variants.diff_from: dit_duo_v1 — adds contact_head (5 future modes x H + coupling logit) on the two pooled conditioners, aux CE/BCE loss (head_w), step weights

variants.name: π0.5-Duo v1 (two-stream gated suffix, shared expert)
variants.host: π0.5 (lerobot 0.6.1 PI05Policy), VLM prefix shared, state text removed from the prompt
variants.streams: suffix = [state_L, 50 left action tokens, state_R, 50 right action tokens]; the SAME pretrained action-expert weights process both; learned stream embeddings; per-stream in/out projections sliced from the pretrained 32-d projections (cols/rows 0:7, 7:14); each stream sees only its own 7-d state token (+ presence flag)
variants.coupling: block mask inside the suffix self-attention — gate 0 = the two streams cannot see each other (two per-arm experts over one prefix), gate 1 = the original joint expert
variants.gate: contact rule (gate_train on raw state/chunk) at train; gate_online from measured state at eval; duo_g3 adds zzm's g3 state hiding
variants.init: pretrained π0.5 base (zzm RoboTwin base ckpt)

variants.name: π0.5-Duo, gate always open
variants.coupling: same block structure but gate forced to 1 for every sample (DUO_TRAIN_GATE=1) — the streams always attend each other
variants.diff_from: pi05_duo_v1 — only the gate; this is what the official-protocol number 80.36 / 46.36 was produced with

variants.name: π0.5-Duo v2 (anticipatory gate + critical-point weights + future-contact head)
variants.gate: train gate = coupled anywhere in the next 25 steps (simulator ground-truth labels contact_v2); eval gate = head prediction OR causal rule; ablations nohead / nocp / l1 / appr / ovs / gate / sg
variants.diff_from: pi05_duo_v1 — labels from simulator replay, anticipatory gate, per-step weights 1+4·exp(-d/5), aux head 0.2

variants.name: π0.5-Duo v3 (contact tokens)
variants.streams: same + C=10 contact tokens inside the suffix that predict future contact modes; both streams always read them
variants.diff_from: pi05_duo_v2 — ME-Dex style consequence tokens instead of a pooled head

variants.name: Duo-FastWAM (shared blocks, 2T tokens)
variants.host: Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video expert + 30x1024 ActionDiT, MoT), official RoboTwin weights
variants.streams: one ActionDiT processes 2T tokens = [left 7-d tokens; right 7-d tokens]; RoPE positions 0..T-1 for both; learned arm embedding; per-arm encoder/head sliced from the 14-d ones
variants.coupling: the MoT self-attention between the two token halves (duo_cross=true = always open; false = masked off). No CrossArm modules.
variants.init: official robotwin_uncond_3cam_384.pt (sees randomized scenes -> not leaderboard protocol)

variants.name: FLOWER + Duo-DiT (pretrained FlowBlock streams)
variants.host: FLOWER VLA (Florence-2-base encoder, flower_bimanual_v3), pretrained FLOWER action head 360000_model_weights.pt
variants.streams: left stream = FLOWER's 12x1024 FlowBlock DiT (pretrained), right stream = deepcopy; per-arm action in/out MLPs and per-arm proprio MLPs new; the Florence-2 encoder runs twice (head + left wrist + prompt + text, head + right wrist + ...), each stream reads its own encoding
variants.coupling: CrossArm = nn.MultiheadAttention (no qk-norm, no RoPE) after blocks 2,4,6,8, both directions, tanh gain zero-init
variants.init: pretrained FLOWER head for both streams (deepcopy)

variants.name: FLOWER + custom DuoDiT (va_bimanual_b DiTBlock streams, from scratch)
variants.host: FLOWER Florence-2 encoder (same observation path as flower_duo_flowblock); FLOWER's own action blocks discarded
variants.streams: two ArmHead = 8x512 adaLN-zero DiTBlocks (va_bimanual_b.models.dit_flow.DiTBlock), own 7-d state into the pooled conditioner
variants.gate: contact_gate from batch, open when absent (RoboTwin: always open)
variants.init: from scratch (FLOWER head weights cannot initialise these blocks)
variants.diff_from: flower_duo_flowblock — stream architecture (8x512 scratch vs 12x1024 pretrained), qk-norm CrossArm, gate plumbing

variants.name: FLOWER + custom DuoDiT + RoPE
variants.coupling: same, RoPE inside the CrossArm attention too
variants.diff_from: flower_duo_custom — RoPE (action_rope.enable_rope) in every stream self-attention and in CrossArm; no learned positions

variants.name: OpenWAM + DuoDiT legacy (joint_cross_attn, 14-D joints)
variants.host: OpenWAM-Alpha (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video DiT frozen), variant joint_cross_attn, 256x256, bridge layers 0,4,...,28
variants.streams: two 7-d streams (va_bimanual_b-style) read the video features through cross-attention bridges; lambda_video 0
variants.init: OpenWAM-Alpha pretrain foundation model; action head new
variants.code: /mnt/workspace/yangyq/openwam_duodit_robotwin (train_robotwin_duo_dit.sh, _stage2.sh); model file in the OpenWAM source tree (not copied)

variants.name: OpenWAM native dual ActionDiT (two full pretrained experts, EEF)
variants.host: OpenWAM-Alpha (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video DiT TRAINED, lambda_video 1), variant joint_self_attn, attention_mask_mode mutual, 384x320 three-camera canvas, 33 frames stride 4
variants.streams: left = full pretrained ActionDiT (30x1024), right = second full copy; each a 10-d EEF stream (xyz, rot6d, gripper) in the official 80-d unified action space, slots 0-9 / 34-43; both share the MoT joint attention with the video tokens
variants.coupling: MoT mask blocks left<->right; CrossArm (va_bimanual_b CrossArm, qk-norm) + RoPE after every even layer (15 per direction), tanh gain zero-init
variants.init: native_dual_warm_start — every pretrained tensor copied to both arms, action_encoder columns / action_decoder rows sliced per arm; CrossArm new
variants.diff_from: openwam_duo_legacy — pretrained experts instead of new streams, EEF instead of joints, video expert trained, official 5-epoch recipe

variants.name: Duo-DiT + per-arm / shared JEPA perception (planned)
variants.host: frozen DINOv2-B (layers 4/8/12) + Adapter, no VLM; CLIP instruction token
variants.streams: R3 layout (head + own wrist + own state) with FLARE future tokens; CrossArm (GatedCross) at 2,4,6,8; optional JEPA subgoal tokens via a second GatedCross set
variants.coupling: GatedCross, gate = sigmoid(w·s2) learned from the shared JEPA latent (or none / rule)
variants.repo: (lives in YYQ_Quic_EX; uses the same CrossArm as duo/coupling.py)
